source.note: The plan's own source (Kenney Nature Kit, zip pinned by sha256; the kit page currently links https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/nature-kit/37ac38a37b-1677698939/kenney_nature-kit.zip). The kit has three red mushrooms: `mushroom_red` (squat, a stem nearly as wide as the cap), `mushroom_redTall` and `mushroom_redGroup` (a cluster). `mushroom_redTall` is used instead of the plan's `mushroom_red`: its slender stem under a wide conical cap reads best as a lone fly agaric / toadstool. Height 0.2 m: a mature fly agaric stands 0.15-0.3 m, and 0.2 m gives this model a 10 cm cap, true to life. The model has no white spots (Kenney's mushrooms are plain red), so the cap is the noon vermilion (`accent`) over the dark brown (`iris`) shade, and the stem and gills (one source material, `_defaultMat`) are cream (`moon`) over paper (`sky`). A hexagonal low-poly prism (48 tris), kept faceted (`smooth: false`; smooth normals turned the whole stem to its shade tone). Static, no clips.
